purpose: Navigate between labelled anchors within a long form or bounded workspace without owning section state.
accessibility: Expose a named nav landmark and aria-current=location for the active anchor.
Keep native anchor and summary keyboard behavior; the consumer may supply scroll-spy state through activeId.
responsive: Render the labelled anchor list on wide layouts.
Collapse to a native details summary and compact anchor menu on narrow layouts without changing item semantics.
motion: Uses the shared transition and easing variables for mobile disclosure.

api.name: items
api.description: Labelled section IDs rendered as page-local anchors.

api.name: activeId
api.description: Consumer-controlled active section, such as a scroll-spy result.

api.name: defaultActiveId
api.description: Initial active section for uncontrolled navigation.

api.name: onSectionChange
api.description: Callback after an anchor is selected; section observation remains consumer-owned.

api.name: label
api.description: Accessible name for the page-local nav landmark.

api.name: sticky
api.description: Keep the navigation below the shared document sticky offset.
